name: Bijutsu Kyoushi Ryouko
source:
Ryouko is a motivated casual art teacher. There's no particular why main character likes her, there's just the right atmosphere around her. But she is adult, so it's natural to develop romantic feelings over a beautiful woman. Well, probably it's not ordinary student-teacher relations...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-january-2003-moekan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
Ryouko是一位积极主动的休闲美术老师。主角喜欢她并没有什么特别的原因，只是她周围的气氛很合适。但她已经是成年人了，对一个美丽的女人产生浪漫的感情是很自然的。嗯，大概不是普通的师生关系……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-january-2003-moekan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
